 Schools in several states will observe a holiday on October 26 for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 2026. Check the state-wise list and latest Uttar Pradesh update.

 Valmiki jayanti 2026: schools closed on October 26 in which states? Check full list Schools close on Oct 26 for Valmiki Jayanti.
 Holiday applies in several Indian states.
 Students should check local school notices.
 Did our AI summary help? 
 Schools in several Indian states will remain closed on Monday, October 26, 2026, on the occasion of Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti. Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh and Punjab are among the states where the day is listed as a holiday. Uttar Pradesh has also announced a public holiday for the occasion, according to reports published on October 25.
 However, school holidays may vary across states and institutions. Students and parents should check official school notices before making plans for Monday.
 Schools closed on October 26: State-wise list 
 According to published holiday calendars and reports, the following states and Union Territories have October 26 listed as a holiday for Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti:
 Haryana
 Himachal Pradesh
 Karnataka
 Madhya Pradesh
 Punjab
 Delhi
 Chandigarh
 Uttar Pradesh
 The Uttar Pradesh government announced a public holiday on October 26, with government and private schools expected to remain closed. The holiday is also applicable to educational institutions covered by the state government's order.

 Are all schools closed on October 26 in India? 
 No. Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti is not a compulsory nationwide holiday for every school. The closure depends on state government notifications, local administrative orders and individual school calendars.
 Private schools, including CBSE- and ICSE-affiliated institutions, may follow their respective calendars, subject to applicable government directions. Students should check their school's official website, notice board or parent communication group for confirmation.
 Why is Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti celebrated? 
 Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti marks the birth anniversary of Maharishi Valmiki, who is traditionally regarded as the author of the Ramayana. He is also known as the Adi Kavi, meaning the first poet in Sanskrit literature.
 The occasion is observed through prayers, religious gatherings and cultural programmes. In Uttar Pradesh, authorities have also planned events associated with the occasion, including Ramayana recitations and devotional programmes.
 What must students check for October 26? 
 Students should confirm whether their school has declared a holiday before travelling to the campus. They should also check for any updated circulars issued by the school or local administration.
 As holiday arrangements differ by region and institution, the latest official notification remains the most reliable source for confirming school closures on October 26.
